facts.value: bool (Fighter_GObj*): synchronous mutating probe requiring a valid writable Fighter. It updates fighter contact bookkeeping and qualifying overlapping Item objects in place. True means probing was enabled and the post-scan dmg.x1950 flag caused ftCo_800C703C to run, after which x1950 was cleared. It does not prove a fresh overlap because x1950 is not cleared on entry.
facts.rationale: Independently confirms the librarian's correction to the baseline's overly strong fresh-contact interpretation.

evidence.why: Signature, mutations, entry gates, absence of entry clear, and post-scan response/return establish the exact contract.

facts.value: If x2219_b1 or x2223_b4 is set, returns false without changing geometry, x2223_b5, or x1950. Otherwise sets x2223_b5, reconstructs x1930.xC, and scans the whole item list, setting x1950 for each eligible overlap without clearing its entry value. A set post-scan x1950 invokes ftCo_800C703C once, clears the flag, and returns true; an unset flag returns false. An empty list can therefore return true with a preexisting flag. Every overlap receives metadata; there is no first-hit break or existing-contact guard. Reviewed environmental Boolean callers return false on probe success, overriding their ordinary map result.
facts.rationale: Repairs the no-new-overlap-implies-false claim while preserving verified gating, aggregation, and caller priority.

evidence.why: Complete local control flow establishes state transitions and aggregation.
Boolean caller prioritizes probe success over its ordinary map result.
